title: Police Warning
intro: Chapter 4. These scams don't charm you. They scare you.
Fear makes people skip every check. That's the whole trick.
An official-looking email just arrived. Breathe, then sniff.

notify.text: URGENT: Your wallet is linked to a criminal case

p.text: Your crypto wallet has been linked to money laundering.
Do not discuss this case with anyone, including your bank.

fine.label: Fine paid in crypto
fine.lens: Police don't take fines in crypto.
fine.why: Only scammers demand payment in crypto.

deadline.label: 24-hour threat
deadline.why: Real police don't threaten arrest by email to get paid.

secret.label: Tell no one
secret.why: Scammers isolate you so nobody can warn you.

addr.label: Free webmail address
addr.lens: mailbox-eu.com is a generic mail service.
addr.why: Real authorities use their official domain.

crime.label: Scary accusation
crime.lens: You're accused of a crime out of nowhere.

from.label: Official-sounding name
from.why: Any name can be typed in. Proves nothing.

subject.label: Case number
subject.why: Numbers look official but are easy to invent.

actions.label: Pay the fine to avoid trouble
Call the police on their official number from their website
Report it as phishing and delete it

block_report.line: Reported. The same email went to thousands of crypto holders that night.

verify.line: The real police: "We never ask for fines in crypto. That's a scam."

go_ahead.line: There was no case. The €1,500 went straight to Mirage.

what_if.go_ahead: Police never ask for fines in crypto, and never tell you to keep it from your bank.

golden_rule: Real police, tax offices and banks never demand payment in crypto, and never tell you to keep it secret.

quick_check.q: An email says pay a fine in crypto within 24 hours or be arrested. What is it?

options.text: Probably real, pay to be safe
A scam: real authorities never ask for crypto
Reply and ask for a discount

quick_check.explain: Fear plus crypto payment is always a scam.

hints.nudge: How do they want you to pay?

rows.k: Do police fine you in crypto?
